My first Rmarkdown file
=====================

this is my first R md file.
here, we're goind to load some data.

```{r}
library(datasets)
data("airquality")
summary(airquality)
```

let's make a plot

```{r}
pairs(airquality)
```

here's a regrssion model o fozone on wind, solar radiation, and temperature.

```{r, results = "asis"}
library(stats)
fit <- lm(Ozone ~ Wind + Solar.R + Temp, data = airquality)
summary(fit)
library(xtable)
xt <- xtable(summary(fit))
print(xt, type = "html")
```
